        "severity": "high",
        "description": "Version numbering is non-monotonic across the declared release chain. version_access states March 2025 = Version 1.4, June 2025 = Version 2.1 and October 2025 = Version 2.1, while this June 2026 release declares version '2.0' and the citation string ends 'V2'. A later release carrying a lower version number than two of its predecessors cannot be ordered by a consumer, and the record does not reconcile the discrepancy.",
        "fields_involved": ["version", "version_access.versions_available", "citation", "related_datasets"],
        "recommendation": "Reconcile the release version series: either correct the version string for this release so it succeeds the October 2025 release, or state explicitly in version_access why the Dataverse version counter restarted, so that version ordering is machine-resolvable."
      },
      {
        "type": "consistency",
        "severity": "high",
        "description": "file_collections classifies six of ten archives as collection_type 'processed_data', yet no processing is documented anywhere: preprocessing_strategies, cleaning_strategies, labeling_strategies, machine_annotation_tools, annotation_analyses, imputation_protocols and missing_data_documentation are all absent. The record asserts that processing occurred but never describes it for the released files.",
        "fields_involved": ["file_collections.collection_type", "preprocessing_strategies", "cleaning_strategies", "labeling_strategies", "machine_annotation_tools", "imputation_protocols", "missing_data_documentation"],
        "recommendation": "Add preprocessing_strategies and cleaning_strategies describing how the AP-MS, SEC-MS and perturb-seq raw signal was converted into the distributed processed archives, naming the software and versions used (e.g. the search engine and quantification pipeline for the MS data, the alignment and guide-calling pipeline for perturb-seq)."
      },
      {
        "type": "consistency",
        "severity": "medium",
        "description": "regulatory_restrictions is populated but carries no confidentiality_level classification, and no hipaa_compliant or other_compliance values are recorded. The record states what is not regulated (FDA: No, no export control) without ever classifying the confidentiality tier of the data it distributes.",
        "fields_involved": ["regulatory_restrictions", "regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level"],
        "recommendation": "Add regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level with an explicit classification (e.g. public/open) so that the absence of restriction is an asserted classification rather than an omission."
      },
      {
        "type": "content_accuracy",
        "severity": "medium",
        "description": "The record asserts AI-readiness throughout (description, purposes, intended_uses 'AI model training', conforms_to_schema) but supplies no variable-level metadata: the variables slot is absent, no internal file format is named, and the only declared distribution format is the ZIP container. A consumer cannot determine the structure or semantics of the data inside the archives from this datasheet.",
        "fields_involved": ["variables", "distribution_formats", "conforms_to", "purposes", "intended_uses"],
        "recommendation": "Populate variables with the measured fields per modality and declare the internal formats of each ZIP (e.g. OME-TIFF/PNG for imaging, mzML/TSV for MS, MTX/H5AD for perturb-seq) so the AI-readiness claim is supported by machine-actionable structure."
      },
      {
        "type": "correctness",
        "severity": "medium",
        "description": "The single access URL in distribution_formats, 'https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/api/access/datafile/', is a bare API stem with no datafile identifier appended. It is structurally well-formed but not resolvable to any file, so it does not constitute an actionable download path.",
        "fields_involved": ["distribution_formats.access_urls"],
        "recommendation": "Record per-collection access URLs including the Dataverse datafile persistent IDs, or the dataset landing page URL at doi.org/10.18130/V3/HIGT4C, in place of the truncated API stem."
      },
      {
        "type": "semantic_understanding",
        "severity": "medium",
        "description": "conforms_to asserts RO-Crate packaging while simultaneously disclosing that the assertion is carried from the preprint and the March/June 2025 releases and is not restated by the June 2026 release page, whose only metadata artifact is 'cm4ai_release_metadata.zip' of unstated internal format. The conformance claim is therefore unverified for the record's own subject.",
        "fields_involved": ["conforms_to", "conforms_to_standard", "file_collections", "source_caveats"],
        "recommendation": "Either confirm RO-Crate packaging for this release and point conforms_to at the specific artifact that carries the crate manifest, or downgrade the claim to a statement about prior releases under related_datasets."
      },
      {
        "type": "semantic_understanding",
        "severity": "medium",
        "description": "The FAIRSCAPE/EVI provenance-graph capability is described only in the free-text notes slot; the structured provenance slots that would carry it (was_derived_from, parent_datasets) are empty, and no entity-activity-agent relationship or processing lineage is expressed for any released file. Provenance is claimed at framework level but not instantiated at record level.",
        "fields_involved": ["notes", "was_derived_from", "parent_datasets", "conforms_to"],
        "recommendation": "Populate was_derived_from for each file_collection linking it to its raw_data_sources entry and the acquisition activity that produced it, so the provenance graph asserted in notes is realised in the datasheet."
      },
      {
        "type": "completeness",
        "severity": "medium",
        "description": "known_biases contains a single entry (representation_bias). Biases that the record itself evidences elsewhere are not categorised: sampling_strategies records is_random=false with targeted selection of cell lines and perturbation targets (selection bias), and known_limitations records incompletely overlapping protein sets across SEC-MS, IF and perturb-seq (measurement/coverage bias). future_use_impacts is absent, so no fairness or social-impact analysis accompanies the bias statement.",
        "fields_involved": ["known_biases", "sampling_strategies.is_random", "known_limitations", "future_use_impacts"],
        "recommendation": "Add known_biases entries typed selection_bias (targeted, non-random choice of cell lines and perturbation targets) and measurement_bias (modality-dependent protein coverage), and add future_use_impacts describing downstream risks of training on a two-cell-line corpus with mitigation guidance."
      },
      {
        "type": "consistency",
        "severity": "low",
        "description": "The page slot points to the project portal (https://cm4ai.org/) rather than the landing page of the DOI-identified release in the University of Virginia Dataverse. Findability is satisfied by doi and publisher, but the landing page for this specific version is not given.",
        "fields_involved": ["page", "doi", "publisher"],
        "recommendation": "Set page to the Dataverse landing page for doi:10.18130/V3/HIGT4C and retain cm4ai.org under external_resources, where it is already listed."
      },
      {
        "type": "consistency",
        "severity": "low",
        "description": "Ravitsky V is recorded in creators with affiliation 'University of Montreal' but appears in ethical_reviews with the contact address ravitskyv@thehastingscenter.org. The two organisational attributions are unreconciled.",
        "fields_involved": ["creators", "ethical_reviews.contact_person"],
        "recommendation": "State both affiliations for this individual, or note in creators which institution the ethical-review role is exercised on behalf of."
      },
      {
        "type": "correctness",
        "severity": "low",
        "description": "File sizes are recorded as prose inside file_collections notes ('113.3 KB', '3.8 GB') rather than in the structured total_bytes/total_size_bytes slots, and MD5 checksums are likewise embedded in free text. The integrity and size metadata is present and specific but not machine-readable.",

        "recommendation": "Lift the per-collection byte counts and MD5 digests out of notes into the structured size and checksum slots, and add a release-level total_size_bytes."
      },

        "type": "correctness",
        "severity": "low",
        "description": "Ontology codes on instances (B2AI_SUBSTRATE:19, B2AI_TOPIC:15, B2AI_SUBSTRATE:59, B2AI_TOPIC:26, B2AI_SUBSTRATE:64, B2AI_TOPIC:34, B2AI_SUBSTRATE:58) are given as bare CURIEs with no human-readable labels and no prefix declaration binding them to a resolvable namespace, so a reader cannot verify that the assigned substrate and topic terms match the described modality.",

        "recommendation": "Replace 'mass spectroscopy' with 'mass spectrometry'."
      },

        "type": "consistency",
        "severity": "low",
        "description": "Access signals are mixed and not resolved into a stated access tier. The licence is permissive (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) implying unauthenticated download, while data_governance describes a Data Access Committee supervising distribution and raw_data_sources marks two perturb-seq sources 'Embargoed'. The datasheet never states which access tier applies to the ten distributed archives.",

      }

    "semantic_insights": [
      "DOI 10.18130/V3/HIGT4C carries the University of Virginia Libraries (LibraData/Dataverse) prefix 10.18130 and is consistent with publisher https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/ and with the citation's 'University of Virginia Dataverse' — identifier, publisher and citation agree.",
